name: branding-aurora-cosmetics-bottles-on-green-steps-and-peach-plinths
title: Aurora natural cosmetics: green bottles on peach plinths and cream bottles on green steps
whatItIs: A split image: left, a dark green pump bottle and tube with vertical orange 'aurora' wordmarks on grey plinths against peach with an orange disc; right, three cream bottles with orange caps on stepped green blocks.
whatItMeans: Fresh and bold; swapping bottle and background colours shows a flexible two-colour system.
techniques: Invert the palette between product and set.
Stage bottles on steps and plinths for rhythm.
Run a lowercase wordmark vertically up the bottle.

vocabulary.definition: A block or pedestal used to display a product.
